card_info.name: Poke Ball
card_info.card_text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokemon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card_info.name: Pokemon Catcher
card_info.card_text: Switch your opponent's Active Pokemon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokemon.

card_info.name: Potion
card_info.card_text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokemon

card_info.name: Professor Kukui
card_info.card_text: Draw 2 cards. During this turn, your Pokemon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokemon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

card_info.name: Rare Candy
card_info.card_text: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokemon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokemon, put that card on the Basic Pokemon. (This counts as evolving that Pokemon.) You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokemon that was put into play this turn.

card_info.name: Repel
card_info.card_text: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokemon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokemon.

card_info.name: Rotom Dex
card_info.card_text: Count the number of your remaining Prize cards and shuffle them into your deck. Then, add that number of cards to your Prize cards from the top of your deck.

card_info.name: Switch
card_info.card_text: Switch 1 of your Active Pokemon with 1 of your Benched Pokemon.

card_info.name: Team Skull Grunt
card_info.card_text: Your opponent reveals his or her hand. Discard 2 Energy you find there.

card_info.name: Timer Ball
card_info.card_text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads. search your deck for an Evolution Pokemon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card_info.name: Ultra Ball
card_info.card_text: Discard 2 cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 cards, you can't play this card.) Search your deck for a Pokemon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

card_info.name: Double Colorless Energy
card_info.card_text: Double Colorless Energy provides [C][C] Energy.

card_info.name: Rainbow Energy
card_info.card_text: This card provides [C] Energy. While in play, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokemon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokemon.

card_info.name: Lurantis GX (Full Art)
attacks:
[G] Flower Supply (40)
Attach 2 Basic Energy from your discard pile to your Pokemon in any way you like.

[1GG] Solar Blade (120)
Heal 30 damage from this Pokemon.

[G] ChloroScythe GX (50x)
This attack does 50 damage times the number of Grass Energy attached to this Pokemon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

card_info.name: Lapras GX (Full Art)
attacks:
[W] Collect
Draw 3 cards.

[WWW] Blizzard Burn (160)
This Pokemon can't attack during your next turn.

[1WW] Ice Beam GX (100)
Your opponent's Active Pokemon is now Paralyzed. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

card_info.name: Espeon GX (Full Art)
attacks:
[1] Psybeam (30)
Your opponent's Active Pokemon is now Confused.

[2P] Psychic (60+)
Does 30 more damage for eachEnergy attached to your opponent's Active Pokemon.

[2P] Division GX
Put 10 damage counters on your opponent's Pokemon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

card_info.name: Lunala GX (Full Art)
card_info.card_text:
Ability — Psychic Transfer
As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a [P] Energy from 1 of your Pokemon to another one of your Pokemon.
attacks:
[PPPP] Moongeist Beam (120)
The Defending Pokemon can't be healed during your opponent's next turn.

[PPP] Lunar Fall GX
Knock out 1 of your opponent's Basic Pokemon that isn't a Pokemon GX. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

card_info.name: Umbreon GX (Full Art)
attacks:
[D] Strafe (30)
You may switch this Pokemon with 1 of your Benched Pokemon.

[D2] Shadow Bullet (90)
This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)

[D1] Dark Call GX
Discard 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Pokemon in play. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

card_info.name: Solgaleo GX (Full Art)
card_info.card_text:
Ability — Ultra Road
Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch your Active Pokemon with 1 of your Benched Pokemon.
attacks:

Discard all Energy from this Pokemon.

Search your deck for up to 5 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokemon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
